title: He Mows With His Eyes SHUT 🌿
description:
My neighbor mows his lawn at three in the morning, with his eyes shut. Don't look while it's running. His grass is the greenest on the street.

My dad has fought that lawn for ten years, and ours has one bald spot he can't fix. This Friday he set an alarm to catch him.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment PEEK if you would have looked.
